title: Run a coding agent on your laptop with no internet
summary: Engineer Rittika Jindal, living in the Himalayan foothills, set up OpenCode with a local Qwen model to diagnose and fix a buggy expense calculator offline.
agent_role: The agent reads project files, runs the tests and proposes edits, all through a model running on the laptop. The author approves every file edit and command before it runs.
what_they_did: Rittika Jindal, a principal engineer, often loses internet and power where she lives. She downloaded a free model that runs on a laptop and connected it to the OpenCode agent, with web tools blocked. Then she disconnected and asked the agent to explain and fix a small expense calculator that failed three tests.
worth_knowing: Download the model, project packages and test tools before going offline; anything needing a new package or web lookup still needs a connection. The 9B model is about 7 GB and needs roughly 12–16 GB of memory.
prompt: I want to work offline with you on [project folder]. First, while I'm online, list everything I need downloaded so you can work without internet: the local model, project packages and test tools. Once I'm offline, read [file name] and run the existing tests. Explain the bug without editing any files. Then propose a fix and show me the changes before applying them, and rerun the tests after I approve.

curation.rationale: A clear, reproducible walkthrough with a repo for running a coding agent fully offline on a laptop, a practical need for travelers and remote workers. The excerpt ends before the final result, so the outcome is not shown.
